1. In Waterloo, it's very easy to get caught up in what others are doing and have "herd mentality." Don't be a sheep. Try as hard as possible not to devell on the "ideal path" and instead carve out your own journey. Learn what YOU want to learn, work wherever seems most interesting to YOU, and make decisions you believe are right for your OWN growth. 2. There will always be another due date. Go outside and touch some grass gang. You'll always find a way to finish that assignment but you won't be able to back in time and make those spontaneous plans with your best friends. 3. It can be very easy to focus on the "next step ahead" throughout co-op terms, but its so important to stop resume and interview maxxing and actually learn in the moment.
